faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at AIIMS Nagpur?
faq.answer: AIIMS Nagpur has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the post of Project Technical Support III under the Biochemistry project titled “Targeting Lung cancer cells with Panchagavya conjugated PDL1 blocking peptides through Polyoxometalate (POM) Quantum-Container Derived Liposomes”.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support III post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to send the scanned copy of the application by email is 10 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. with three-year experience in a relevant subject or a post graduate degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or Microbiology, along with verbal and written proficiency in English.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with relaxations applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must send a scanned copy of the filled application form (Annexure 1) along with supporting documents and bio-data to [email protected] on or before 10 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test if needed, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed consolidated emolument of Rs. 28,000 per month plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary for 9 months under an externally sponsored project and does not offer any claim for a regular post at AIIMS Nagpur.
